content.title: About
content.content: The whole grain reduced-fat waffle is made from whole wheat kernels, enriched with fiber and contains minimal fat. It has a crisp golden crust and a soft interior, suitable for breakfast or a snack.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain waffles retain the bran and germ, boosting their nutritional value.
Reduced fat is achieved through air‑baking technology and fat substitutes.
Waffles are easy to store and can be reheated in a toaster, microwave, or oven.
The product is often used in children’s meals because of its soft texture and low fat content.
Waffles can serve as a base for sweet or savory dishes: with berries, yogurt, cottage cheese, or avocado.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grains provide dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion and satiety.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The reduced‑fat content makes the waffle suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Complex carbohydrates deliver steady energy without sharp blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Whole grains supply thiamine, niacin, and folate, which aid metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The waffle provides magnesium and iron, important for muscle function and blood formation.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: The product contains gluten and is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some varieties may contain added sugar; individuals monitoring glucose should check the label.

items.title: Loss of crispness if stored improperly
items.content: Moisture can make the waffle soft, so keep it in a dry environment.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The waffle can be enjoyed as a standalone snack, served with yogurt, fruit, nut butter, or used as a base for sandwiches. For extra crunch, toast it briefly.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the waffle in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life, keep it in the refrigerator to maintain its crisp texture.
